Meṅganātha
astronomer. q. by Nārāyaṇa in Muhūrtamārtaṇḍavallabhā. See Bhāratīya Jyotiśśāstra Kā Itihās, p. 122.

Meṅganātha
son of Rāmacandra.
--Nṛsimhārādhana Ratnamālā or Śrautapaddhati in 9 paṭalas. vaiṣ.

Meṅganātha
of Sarvajña family, later than 1270 A. D.
--Rudrānuṣṭhānapaddhati or ºdīpikā. Alph. List Beng. Govt. p. 99. (no. 41).

.
See Kane, HDS. I. ii. p. 1206a.

Meṅganātha(rya)(dāri)
father of (Śeṣa) Kamalākara (a. of C. Sāhityaratnamālā on Jayadeva's Gītagovinda, Adyar D.

Meṅganātha Bhaṭṭa
son of Kṛṣṇa Bhaṭṭa an. father of Gopāla Bhaṭṭa (a. of Cc.. Mitākṣarā on C.. Tantravārttika of Kumārila on C. Bhāṣya of Śābara on Mīmāṃsāsūtra, ASB. IV. ii. 411).
